token_contract.claim: Access generation computes expiry from the current issue time and configured access minutes. It does not use refresh expiry.
Refresh generation computes a separate expiry from current issue time, configured refresh minutes, and 24000 milliseconds.
The extend endpoint validates the access credential and session, then issues an access credential. It does not replace refresh.
The relogin endpoint validates refresh issuer, expiry, and session, then builds a new access credential.
The provider validates individual credential expiry. No inspected rule requires refresh expiry to follow access expiry.

supported_state_inference.explanation: Let an existing refresh expire at E_R and access lifetime be T_A. An access extension at E_R minus T_A can produce matching deadlines. A slightly later extension can place access expiry after refresh expiry. Both credentials can remain valid at issuance. Earlier refresh acquisition can be absent or skipped. Source does not impose deadline ordering.
